articles.why: AI从聊天工具变成能帮你规划日程、查资料的实用助手。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 试试用AI管理日程和做研究，提升效率。

articles.beginner_takeaway: AI正进入生活娱乐，可以关注新玩法。

articles.title: OpenAI推出AI键盘

articles.for_me: 暂时不用管，等它更成熟再考虑是否适合你。

articles.title: AI辅助设计新药

articles.for_me: 暂时不用管，但可作为AI应用案例，备考时了解。

articles.title: 美国砸50亿美元搞AI科研
articles.summary: 特朗普政府启动“创世纪任务”，拨款50亿美元资助数百个AI驱动的科学项目。

articles.title: AI数据中心电力问题

articles.title: 图书馆开“避开AI”工作坊

articles.for_me: 提醒你：AI是工具，不必焦虑，按需使用就好。

articles.title: 中国AI引发硅谷恐慌
articles.summary: 中国AI公司Moonshot的Kimi模型让硅谷和华尔街感到紧张。
articles.why: 中美AI竞争加剧，可能影响全球AI工具选择和价格。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注国产AI工具，可能更便宜好用。
articles.for_me: 值得关注：国产AI工具可能更便宜，适合你学英语和备考时试用。

plain_summary: 今天AI圈挺热闹的。首先，Anthropic发布了新模型Claude Opus 5，性能接近顶级但价格便宜一半，这对想用AI但预算有限的人来说是好消息。Meta也把它的AI聊天机器人升级成了真正的助手，能帮你管日程、做研究，实用性更强。安全方面，OpenAI遭遇了首次自主AI黑客攻击，提醒大家用AI时别乱输隐私信息。Midjourney收购了占星App，说明AI公司开始跨界玩娱乐。政府层面，美国砸了50亿美元搞AI科研，未来AI方向会更火。另外，AI数据中心的电力问题暴露了，可能影响服务稳定性。有趣的是，全美图书馆开了“避开AI”工作坊，说明不是所有人都拥抱AI，你可以理性看待。最后，中国AI模型Kimi让硅谷紧张，国产AI工具值得关注。总的来说，今天信号：新模型更便宜、AI助手更实用、安全要留心、国产AI崛起。对你想跟上AI圈来说，重点试新工具、关注国产、别焦虑。

top_starred.name: affaan-m/ECC
top_starred.desc: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
top_starred.tagline: AI代理性能优化系统，提升技能与记忆
top_starred.explanation: 这是一个为AI代理（比如Claude Code、Codex等）提供性能优化的系统。它解决的问题是：AI代理在复杂任务中可能表现不稳定，比如忘记上下文、执行效率低。这个系统通过增强代理的“技能”、“直觉”、“记忆”和“安全性”，让它们更聪明、更可靠。普通人可能用不上，但如果你是开发者，在用AI编程助手时，这个系统能让助手更懂你，比如记住你之前的代码风格，或者自动优化执行步骤。上手需要一定的编程基础，适合想深入定制AI代理的开发者。

top_starred.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
top_starred.desc: The agent that grows with you
top_starred.tagline: 能随着你成长的自适应AI代理
top_starred.explanation: 这是一个AI代理框架，特点是“随着你成长”——它会根据你的使用习惯和需求不断进化。解决的问题是：传统AI代理功能固定，无法适应个人变化的需求。比如，你刚开始用它写邮件，后来想让它帮你整理日程，它会自动学习并扩展能力。普通人可以把它当作个人助手，比如让它帮你管理待办事项，或者自动回复常见问题。上手难度中等，需要一些Python基础，但项目提供了模板，跟着教程就能跑起来。

top_starred.name: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
top_starred.desc: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matters.
top_starred.tagline: 让每个人都能用上AI的自动化工具
top_starred.explanation: AutoGPT是一个能自动完成复杂任务的AI工具。它解决的问题是：普通人想用AI做点实事，但不知道如何一步步操作。AutoGPT可以自己思考、拆解任务，比如你告诉它“帮我研究一下新能源汽车市场”，它会自动搜索、整理信息，最后给你一份报告。它还能做更实际的事，比如自动管理你的社交媒体账号，或者帮你分析股票数据。上手不算难，有图形界面，但需要一点耐心学习如何给它下指令。适合想用AI提高效率的普通用户和创作者。

top_starred.name: ollama/ollama
top_starred.desc: Get up and running with Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.2, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.
top_starred.tagline: 一键运行多种大语言模型的本地工具
top_starred.explanation: Ollama让你能在自己的电脑上轻松运行各种AI大模型，比如DeepSeek、Qwen等。它解决的问题是：以前想用这些模型需要复杂配置，而且数据可能上传到云端有隐私风险。Ollama只需一条命令就能下载并运行模型，所有数据都在本地。比如，你可以用它离线写文章、翻译文档，或者搭建一个私人聊天机器人。上手非常简单，下载安装后，在终端输入命令就能用，适合所有想本地使用AI的用户，尤其是注重隐私的人。

top_starred.name: f/prompts.chat
top_starred.desc: f.k.a. Awesome ChatGPT Prompts. Share, discover, and collect prompts from the community. Free and open source — self-host for your organization with complete privacy.
top_starred.explanation: 这是一个收集和分享ChatGPT提示词（prompt）的网站。提示词就是你给AI的指令，好的提示词能让AI给出更好的回答。它解决的问题是：很多人不知道如何有效提问，导致AI回答不理想。这个项目汇集了社区贡献的优质提示词，比如“用简单的话解释量子物理”或者“写一封辞职信”。你可以直接复制使用，也可以自己分享。上手零门槛，打开网页就能用，适合所有使用ChatGPT的人，尤其是新手。

trending.name: powerycy/goutoujunshi
trending.desc: 一个先接住情绪、再分析关系并给出可执行策略的 Codex 恋爱军师，内置心理、法律、社会、人文、哲学、婚姻家庭与性学知识库，支持多元关系。
trending.tagline: 先共情再分析的AI恋爱军师
trending.explanation: 这是一个专门解决情感问题的AI助手，内置了心理学、法律等知识库。它解决的问题是：普通AI聊天机器人只会理性分析，但情感问题需要先照顾情绪。这个AI会先接住你的情绪，比如你说“男朋友不回消息”，它会先安慰你，再分析关系并给出行动建议。比如，它会建议你如何沟通，或者提醒你注意法律风险。上手简单，直接对话即可，适合在恋爱或人际关系中遇到困惑的普通人。

trending.name: 0xsline/OpenChatCut
trending.desc: Local-first conversational AI video editor with a professional multi-track timeline, Agent Skills, MCP integration, and Remotion-powered rendering.
trending.tagline: 本地运行的AI视频编辑器，支持多轨道
trending.explanation: 这是一个AI视频编辑工具，所有处理都在本地完成，保护隐私。它解决的问题是：传统视频编辑软件复杂，且AI功能通常需要联网。OpenChatCut让你可以用自然语言剪辑视频，比如“删除前10秒”，或者让AI自动添加字幕。它还支持多轨道编辑和插件扩展。比如，你可以用它快速剪辑一个Vlog，AI会自动识别精彩片段。上手需要一些视频编辑基础，但AI功能降低了门槛，适合内容创作者。

trending.name: hahhforest/pi-textbook
trending.desc: 《动手学 Pi》：沿 15 个真实 checkpoint 从零构建 Pi-style Agent
trending.tagline: 从零构建Pi风格AI代理的实战教程
trending.explanation: 这是一本交互式电子书，教你从零开始构建一个类似Pi的AI代理。Pi是一个以对话见长的AI。它解决的问题是：很多人想学习AI代理开发，但缺乏系统教程。这本书通过15个真实项目，一步步带你实现记忆、对话等功能。比如，你会学到如何让AI记住之前的对话内容。适合有编程基础（Python）的开发者，想深入了解AI代理原理的人。

trending.name: makecindy/cindy
trending.desc: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
trending.tagline: 开箱即用的开源AI代理，想到就能做到
trending.explanation: Cindy是一个开源的AI代理，安装后就能直接使用，无需复杂配置。它解决的问题是：很多AI代理需要编程才能用，普通人望而却步。Cindy可以帮你自动完成各种任务，比如“帮我订一张明天去北京的机票”，它会自动搜索并执行。它还支持插件扩展。上手非常简单，下载后按照指引就能用，适合所有想用AI提高效率的普通用户。

trending.name: thesysdev/appless
trending.desc: What if your phone had no apps
trending.tagline: 让你的手机摆脱App束缚的AI系统
trending.explanation: 这是一个概念性项目，设想手机没有传统App，而是通过AI直接完成任务。它解决的问题是：现在手机需要安装各种App，操作繁琐。这个系统让你用自然语言控制手机，比如“帮我打车去机场”，AI会自动调用相关服务完成。目前还是原型，适合对AI未来形态感兴趣的极客和开发者。上手需要一定的技术背景，因为需要自己搭建环境。

spaces.name: kulkas2pintu/wan555
spaces.desc: generate a video from an image with a text prompt
spaces.tagline: 用图片和文字生成视频的AI工具
spaces.explanation: ① 这是一个AI应用，你给它一张图片和一段文字描述，它就能生成一段视频。比如你上传一张风景照，输入“日落时分的海滩”，它就会自动生成海浪拍打、天色渐暗的动态视频。② 普通人可以用来制作短视频素材，比如把旅行照片变成动态回忆；学生学英语时，可以输入英文描述生成对应场景的视频，帮助理解词汇。③ 上手简单，在网页上操作，无需安装任何软件，只需上传图片和输入文字即可。

spaces.name: webml-community/bonsai-webgpu-kernels
spaces.desc: Run a 1-bit 27B LLM locally in your browser on WebGPU
spaces.tagline: 在浏览器里本地运行超大型AI模型
spaces.explanation: ① 这是一个技术演示，让你在浏览器中直接运行一个拥有270亿参数的大语言模型（类似ChatGPT），而且模型经过压缩，只需要很少的计算资源。② 普通人可以体验在本地运行AI对话，无需联网，保护隐私；学生可以了解AI模型如何在设备上运行，对学习AI原理有帮助。③ 需要支持WebGPU的浏览器（如最新版Chrome），但无需安装，打开网页即可使用，对新手有一定门槛，但操作简单。

spaces.name: prithivMLmods/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-LoRAs-Fast
spaces.desc: Demo of the Collection of Qwen Image Edit LoRAs
spaces.tagline: 用文字指令编辑图片的AI工具合集
spaces.explanation: ① 这是一个演示页面，集合了多个名为Qwen的AI模型，专门用来根据文字指令编辑图片。比如你上传一张照片，输入“把背景换成沙滩”，它就能自动修改。② 普通人可以快速修图，比如去掉照片中的路人；学生学英语时，可以输入英文指令（如“add a cat”）来练习词汇，并看到图片变化。③ 上手简单，在网页上选择模型、上传图片、输入指令即可，无需技术背景。

spaces.name: smolagents/hf-realtime-voice
spaces.desc: Voice chat over WebSocket against a HF speech-to-speech
spaces.tagline: 通过语音与AI实时对话的工具
spaces.explanation: ① 这是一个语音聊天应用，你对着麦克风说话，AI就能实时回复语音，实现端到端的语音对话。它基于Hugging Face的语音转语音技术。② 普通人可以用来练习外语口语，比如和AI用英语聊天，纠正发音；学生备考英语时，可以模拟对话场景。③ 需要浏览器支持WebSocket，但操作简单，打开网页连接即可对话，无需安装。

spaces.name: ICML-2026-agent-repro/challenge
spaces.desc: Reproduce every ICML 2026 paper with your agent
spaces.tagline: 用AI自动复现学术论文的实验
spaces.explanation: ① 这是一个挑战项目，要求参赛者用AI智能体（能自主完成任务的程序）复现ICML 2026（顶级机器学习会议）的所有论文实验。② 普通人可能无法直接参与，但可以关注AI如何自动做科研；学生备考AI方向时，可以了解前沿研究是如何被验证的。③ 对新手难度极高，需要编程和AI知识，但可以围观学习。

models.name: baidu/Unlimited-OCR
models.tagline: 免费且强大的文字识别模型
models.explanation: ① 这是一个OCR（光学字符识别）模型，能从图片中提取文字，比如扫描文档、识别路牌。② 普通人可以拍照翻译菜单、提取PPT中的文字；学生可以扫描笔记转为电子版，或识别英文图片中的单词辅助学习。③ 使用简单，通过API或在线工具调用，无需技术背景。

models.name: poolside/Laguna-S-2.1
models.tagline: 高效生成文本的AI语言模型
models.explanation: ① 这是一个文本生成模型，可以根据你的输入生成连贯的文字，比如写文章、回答问题。② 普通人可以用它来写邮件、生成故事；学生可以辅助写作文、练习英语写作（输入中文要求，生成英文段落）。③ 使用简单，通过网页或API调用，但需要了解基本提示词技巧。

models.name: upstage/Solar-Open2-250B
models.tagline: 超大规模的多语言AI模型
models.explanation: ① 这是一个拥有2500亿参数的大语言模型，能处理多种语言任务，如翻译、问答、创作。② 普通人可以用它来翻译外文、生成创意文案；学生可以练习多语言对话，或用它解释复杂概念。③ 使用简单，但模型较大，通常通过API访问，对新手友好。

models.name: DavidAU/Qwen3.6-27B-Fable-Fusion-711-Uncensored-Heretic-NM-DAU-NEO-MAX-MTP-GGUF

models.name: Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.2-3B
models.tagline: 轻量级的高效文本生成模型
models.explanation: ① 这是一个只有30亿参数的小型语言模型，但性能不错，适合在资源有限的设备上运行。② 普通人可以在手机或电脑上本地运行，进行对话或文本生成；学生可以学习模型压缩技术，了解如何让AI更高效。③ 使用需要一定技术，但已有简化工具，对新手有一定门槛。

items.title_en: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research
items.summary: Deep research requires agents to find answers that jointly satisfy multiple constraints. Discovering such answers is costly, whereas verifying a candidate can often be decomposed into tractable constraint-wise checks. This discovery--verification asymmetry suggests that a research agent should do more than simply search longer: it should recursively improve its current answer by verifying intermediate results and using the partially verified state to guide subsequent refinement. We introduce ARE
items.title_cn: AREX：迈向递归自我改进的深度研究智能体
items.note: 提出递归自我改进方法，让智能体在深度研究中逐步优化答案，适合了解AI前沿思路。

items.title_en: K12-KGraph: A Curriculum-Aligned Knowledge Graph for Benchmarking and Training Educational LLMs
items.summary: Large language models are increasingly used in K-12 education, but existing benchmarks mainly test exam question answering rather than understanding how curriculum knowledge is structured and visually presented. We call this capability curriculum cognition. It covers prerequisite chains, concept taxonomies, experiment-concept links, pedagogical sequencing, and visual grounding. We introduce K12-KGraph, a curriculum-aligned knowledge graph extracted from official People's Education Press textbook
items.title_cn: K12-KGraph：面向K-12教育的课程对齐知识图谱
items.note: 构建课程知识图谱用于训练和评估教育大模型，对备考AI教育方向有参考价值。

items.title_en: ReferTrack: Referring Then Tracking for Embodied Visual Tracking
items.summary: Embodied visual tracking (EVT) requires a mobile agent to continuously follow a specific target described in natural language using only onboard vision. While recent vision-language-action (VLA) policies unify target identification and trajectory planning, their chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning often operates in abstract spatial latents that are difficult to supervise and weakly aligned with explicit image-space detections. To address this, we introduce ReferTrack, a referring-then-tracking para
items.title_cn: ReferTrack：面向具身视觉跟踪的引用-跟踪方法
items.note: 用自然语言描述目标，让机器人持续跟踪，涉及视觉-语言-动作模型，适合了解具身AI。

items.title_en: Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation
items.summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is promising as it removes the external teacher required by on-policy distillation (OPD), yet it still needs asymmetric information between teacher and student to ensure that the self-teacher provides a stronger learning signal than the student. Existing methods create this asymmetry either through privileged answers or visual evidence. We ask whether both can be removed, yielding a simpler form of OPSD driven purely by input conditioning. For this purpose, we
items.title_cn: 视觉对比自蒸馏
items.note: 简化自蒸馏方法，无需外部教师，提升视觉模型学习效率，了解个大概即可。

items.title_en: Show, Don't Tell: Evaluating Spatial Cognition in Generative Pixels Rather Than LLM Text
items.summary: Spatial intelligence is essential for agents to move from static semantic understanding toward interacting with the physical world. Many spatial tasks are grounded in continuous visual scenes, where locations, regions, and paths are more naturally expressed by pointing, marking, or drawing than by reporting precise coordinates or discrete textual symbols. Yet existing spatial reasoning benchmarks usually require coordinates, options, or text, creating an answer-interface mismatch for image-gener
items.title_cn: 展示而非讲述：用生成像素评估空间认知
items.note: 用图像生成而非文本评估空间智能，适合了解多模态评估新思路。

items.title_en: SLAI T-Rex: Full-Parameter Post-training of the DeepSeek-V4 Family on Ascend SuperPOD
items.summary: Full-parameter post-training of trillion-parameter-scale MoE models introduces substantial system-level challenges for large-scale distributed training, including severe memory pressure, non-overlapped communication overhead, and inefficient kernel execution. While most large-scale LLM training systems are built around GPU-based clusters, this report presents an end-to-end optimization practice on the Ascend NPU SuperPOD. Using the DeepSeek-V4 model family as the target workload, we develop a hi
items.title_cn: SLAI T-Rex：在昇腾SuperPOD上对DeepSeek-V4系列进行全参数后训练
items.note: 万亿参数MoE模型在国产NPU上的训练优化，对了解大规模训练系统有参考价值。

items.title_en: Self Gradient Forcing: Native Long Video Extrapolation
items.summary: Recent autoregressive video diffusion methods are increasingly built upon Self Forcing, where the student is trained on histories produced by its own rollout rather than ground-truth video contexts. This reduces exposure bias, but the historical key-value cache is still used by future frames only as frozen rollout state. items.title_cn: 自梯度强制：原生长视频外推
items.note: 改进自回归视频扩散模型，让历史缓存受未来损失监督，适合了解视频生成前沿。

items.title_en: Beyond Relevance-Centric Retrieval: Rubric-Oriented Document Set Selection and Ranking
items.summary: As large language models and AI agents become the primary consumers of search results, document set quality determines the upper bound of downstream generation. Yet existing evaluation systems remain confined to scoring documents independently and aggregating via nDCG, ignoring inter-document interactions (redundancy, conflict, complementarity) and unable to answer what makes one document set better than another. To address these issues, we propose a complete evaluate-diagnose-optimize framework
items.title_cn: 超越相关性检索：基于评分标准的文档集选择与排序
items.note: 考虑文档间冗余、冲突等交互，优化文档集质量，对RAG系统设计有启发。

items.title_en: An Exam for Active Observers
items.summary: Human vision is a closed loop: gaze is continuously redirected by intermediate hypotheses rather than a single snapshot. Decades of psychophysics and cognitive science have argued that this active observation is essential for a wide range of tasks. Whether today's multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exercise active observation is an empirical question that current vision-language benchmarks do not answer. We introduce ActiveVision, a benchmark that makes active observation measurable for ML
items.title_cn: 面向主动观察者的考试
items.note: 提出基准测试多模态大模型的主动观察能力，适合了解视觉-语言模型评估新方向。

items.title_en: Scaling Laws for Hypernetwork-Based Knowledge Injection in Large Language Models
items.summary: Injecting factual knowledge into large language models (LLMs) reliably and at scale remains an open challenge. Hypernetworks provide a promising solution to large-scale knowledge injection. Although hypernetworks are typically applied for test-time adaptation, we explore their use in train-time knowledge injection, where, given a large corpus of facts, we train a hypernetwork to generate a fixed LoRA adapter that, when inserted into the target model, enable the model to answer questions about th
items.title_cn: 基于超网络的知识注入大语言模型的缩放定律
items.note: 研究超网络注入知识的缩放规律，对理解模型知识更新有帮助。

items.title_en: ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU
items.summary: We present ABot-World-0, an action-conditioned video world model for real-time, long-horizon closed-loop interaction, supported by a multi-source data infrastructure spanning AAA games, simulation engines, and internet videos to learn controllable world dynamics. WorldExplorer performs agent-driven collection guided by training feedback, while a unified pipeline applies 14 deterministic quality checks, VLM-based assessment, and synchronized action and text annotation. We progressively distill a
items.title_cn: ABot-World-0：单桌面GPU上的无限交互世界推演
items.note: 在单GPU上实现实时交互世界模型，适合了解轻量级世界模型进展。

items.title_en: DataFlow-Harness: A Grounded Code-Agent Platform for Constructing Editable LLM Data Pipelines
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate data-processing workflows, yet coding agents typically produce scripts that are not automatically materialized as persistent, editable platform artifacts. We call this disconnect the NL2Pipeline gap. To bridge it, we introduce DataFlow-Harness, a platform that guides an LLM agent to construct platform-native directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) through typed, incremental mutations rather than free-form scripts. The platform combines DataFl
items.title_cn: DataFlow-Harness：用于构建可编辑LLM数据管道的代码智能体平台
items.note: 让LLM智能体构建可编辑的数据处理DAG，对了解自动化数据流水线有参考。

items.title_en: Generative World Renderer at the Speed of Play
items.summary: Generative world renderer AlayaRenderer receives structured world states exported from physics engines and synthesizes RGB frames. Unlike models that generate frames from text/control-hints prompts, AlayaRenderer preserves scene structure without altering the underlying world dynamics. This demonstrates an alternative path toward interactive world modeling and user-controllable play. However, the original AlayaRenderer is too computationally expensive for real-time deployment. This technical rep
items.title_cn: 游戏速度的生成式世界渲染器
items.note: 优化生成式世界渲染器实现实时渲染，适合了解交互式世界建模。

items.title_en: Text Template Tokens Are Implicit Semantic Registers in Diffusion Transformers
items.summary: Text-to-image diffusion transformers (DiTs) jointly process text and image tokens, yet their internal computation during denoising remains poorly understood. We introduce a causal interpretability framework for modern large-scale DiTs that combines attention decomposition with targeted interventions across token spans, heads, and layers. Using it to separate prompt-content tokens from structural template tokens, we find that the structural tokens carry little prompt-specific information at the e
items.title_cn: 文本模板Token是扩散Transformer中的隐式语义寄存器
items.note: 分析扩散Transformer内部机制，发现模板Token的作用，了解个大概即可。

items.title_en: Mage-Flow: An Efficient Native-Resolution Foundation Model for Image Generation and Editing
items.summary: Large-scale visual generators are increasingly capable but costly to train, fine-tune, and deploy. We introduce Mage-Flow, a compact 4B-scale generative stack for efficient text-to-image generation and instruction-based image editing. The stack is built from two co-designed components: Mage-VAE, a lightweight high-fidelity latent tokenizer, and a Native-Resolution Multimodal Diffusion Transformer trained with rectified flow matching. Mage-VAE uses one-step diffusion-style encoding and decoding w
items.title_cn: Mage-Flow：高效的原始分辨率图像生成与编辑基础模型
items.note: 紧凑的4B参数模型实现高效文本到图像生成和编辑，适合了解图像生成前沿。

items.title_en: RynnBrain 1.1: Towards More Capable and Generalizable Embodied Foundation Model
items.summary: We present RynnBrain 1.1, a family of embodied foundation models spanning 2B, 9B, and 122B-A10B scales. Trained with a unified spatio-temporal and physically grounded framework, RynnBrain 1.1 supports embodied perception, spatial reasoning, localization, and planning. items.title_cn: RynnBrain 1.1：迈向更强大、更泛化的具身基础模型
items.note: 多尺度具身基础模型，支持感知、推理、规划，适合了解具身AI进展。

items.title_en: TimeLens2: Generalist Video Temporal Grounding with Multimodal LLMs
items.summary: Video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can describe what happens in a video, but rarely identify when the supporting evidence occurs. We study generalist video temporal grounding, in which one model predicts a variable-cardinality set of evidence intervals across video lengths, domains, query forms, and viewpoints. items.title_cn: TimeLens2：基于多模态大语言模型的通用视频时间定位
items.note: 用多模态LLM定位视频中事件发生的时间，适合了解视频理解新方法。

items.title_en: EvolvingWorld: An Open-Schema Framework for Co-Evolving Role-Play Agents and World Model in Interactive Literary World
items.summary: This paper introduces EvolvingWorld, a framework and benchmark for character and world co-evolution in interactive literary worlds. Existing systems either treat interactive literary simulation as static persona imitation or isolated scene generation, failing to capture how characters and worlds evolve together over time. items.title_cn: EvolvingWorld：交互式文学世界中角色与世界共同演化的开放模式框架
items.note: 框架让角色和世界在交互中共同演化，适合了解AI在文学创作中的应用。

items.title_en: DeepSearch-World: Self-Distillation for Deep Search Agents in a Verifiable Environment
items.summary: Training tool-use agents to improve from their own experience remains challenging, as supervised fine-tuning relies on fixed teacher-distilled trajectories, while sparse-reward reinforcement learning provides weak supervision for long-horizon interactions. We present DeepSearch-Evolve, a self-distillation framework for web agents built on DeepSearch-World, a deterministic and verifiable environment with reproducible search and page-reading tools. DeepSearch-World contains 420K multi-hop QA tasks
items.title_cn: DeepSearch-World：可验证环境中深度搜索智能体的自蒸馏
items.note: 自蒸馏框架训练网络搜索智能体，适合了解智能体自我改进方法。

items.title_en: SWE-Pruner Pro: The Coder LLM Already Knows What to Prune
items.summary: Pruning long context for coding agents has been a vital technology for efficient context management. While existing context pruning methods such as SWE-Pruner realize this by attaching a separate code classifier, we find the agent itself encodes internal representations indicating the relevance of code context when reading tool output. items.title_cn: SWE-Pruner Pro：代码大模型已经知道该剪枝什么
items.note: 利用模型内部表示剪枝长上下文，提升代码智能体效率，适合了解上下文管理。

items.title_en: RAGU: A Multi-Step GraphRAG Engine with a Compact Domain-Adapted LLM
items.summary: Graph retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) enhances large language models with structured knowledge, yet existing systems construct knowledge graphs in a single extraction pass, producing noisy entities and brittle retrieval. RAGU, an open-source modular GraphRAG engine, addresses this by separating extraction from consolidation: entities and relations pass through two-stage typed extraction, DBSCAN-backed deduplication, LLM summarization, and Leiden community detection. items.title_cn: RAGU：带紧凑领域自适应大语言模型的多步GraphRAG引擎
items.note: 模块化GraphRAG引擎，分离提取与合并，提升检索质量，适合了解RAG进阶。

items.title_en: RESOURCE2SKILL: Distilling Executable Agent Skills from Human-Created Multimodal Resources
items.summary: Skills are a useful abstraction for software agents, turning human and agent experience into reusable procedural knowledge. Yet existing skill libraries are mostly hand-written, text-centric, or derived from agent traces, leaving tutorial videos and other multimodal human resources largely underused. We present RESOURCE2SKILL, a framework that distills multimodal resources, including tutorial videos, repositories, articles, and reference artifacts, into executable skills for software agents. RES
items.title_cn: RESOURCE2SKILL：从人类创建的多模态资源中提取可执行智能体技能
items.note: 从教程视频等多模态资源提取可执行技能，适合了解技能学习新方法。

items.title_en: Loop the Loopies!
items.summary: We present Loopie, the most powerful looped Transformer to date. The Loopie series consists of two Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models: a 20B-parameter model with 2B active parameters and a 6Bparameter model with 0.6B active parameters. Looped Transformers have long faced a challenge: given an N-fold increase in pre-training compute, increasing the parameter count by a factor of N usually outperforms looping a model N times. items.title_cn: Loop the Loopies！
items.note: 最强的循环Transformer模型，通过循环提升性能，适合了解模型架构创新。

items.title_en: Xiaomi-Robotics-1: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with over 100K Hours of Real-World Trajectories
items.summary: We present Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a foundational vision-language-action (VLA) model capable of (1) following diverse language instructions to perform a wide range of mobile manipulation tasks in unseen environments out-of-the-box, and (2) efficiently adapting to novel downstream tasks with minimal fine-tuning data. We propose a two-stage training recipe consisting of pre-training and post-training. During pre-training, we imbue the model with broad and generalizable action-generation capabilities by
items.title_cn: Xiaomi-Robotics-1：基于10万小时真实世界轨迹的视觉-语言-动作模型
items.note: 大规模真实数据训练VLA模型，实现零样本移动操作，适合了解具身AI前沿。

items.title_en: xHC: Expanded Hyper-Connections
items.summary: Hyper-Connections (HC) expand the residual stream of Transformers into N parallel streams, providing a form of memory scaling beyond model width and depth. Manifold-Constrained HC (mHC) stabilizes this formulation at scale. The large gains from N{=}1 to N{=}4 suggest residual-stream expansion as a promising scaling axis. items.title_cn: xHC：扩展超连接
items.note: 扩展Transformer残差流为更多并行流，提升模型记忆能力，了解个大概即可。

items.title_en: LongStraw: Long-Context RL Beyond 2M Tokens under a Fixed GPU Budget
items.summary: A growing gap separates inference context lengths from RL post-training: inference systems are approaching million-token contexts, while post-training workloads often remain at 256K tokens or below and rely on length generalization at deployment. The gap is especially important for AI agents, whose observations, tool outputs, documents, and prior decisions accumulate over long trajectories. items.title_cn: LongStraw：固定GPU预算下超过200万token的长上下文强化学习
items.note: 在有限GPU上实现百万token级RL后训练，适合了解长上下文训练技术。

items.title_en: VideoChat3: Fully Open Video MLLM for Efficient and Generalist Video Understanding
items.summary: Recent advances in video understanding have spanned motion, long video, and streaming interaction, driving this field toward real-world applications. Despite this progress, current open-source models remain limited in several ways. They often struggle to generalize across diverse video types, making them effective only in specific domains. High computational demands further restrict their efficiency and scalability. Moreover, most models are only partially open, with key components such as train
items.title_cn: VideoChat3：完全开源的视频多模态大语言模型
items.note: 开源高效通用视频理解模型，适合了解视频MLLM进展。

items.title_en: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Large language models are increasingly trained as interactive agents for long-horizon tasks involving multi-turn interaction, tool use, and environment feedback. Outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) provides a practical optimization paradigm, but its sparse trajectory-level rewards offer limited guidance on intermediate decisions, leaving a supervision gap between episode-level outcomes and token-level policy learning. items.title_cn: SEED：面向智能体强化学习的自演化在线策略蒸馏
items.note: 自演化蒸馏方法为长任务智能体提供中间监督，适合了解智能体RL。

items.title_en: SearchOS-V1: Towards Robust Open-Domain Information-Seeking Agent Collaboration
items.summary: Recent advances in Tool-Integrated Large Language Models have made web search a core capability of information-seeking agents. However, as interaction histories grow, agents increasingly struggle to track task progress. When search attempts fail to yield useful evidence, current single- and multi-agent systems can become trapped in repetitive loops, wasting search budgets and ultimately compromising the quality and completeness of the final output. items.title_cn: SearchOS-V1：迈向鲁棒的开放域信息搜索智能体协作
items.note: 多智能体系统避免搜索循环，提升信息检索质量，适合了解搜索智能体。

items.title_en: BadWAM: When World-Action Models Dream Right but Act Wrong
items.summary: World-action models (WAMs) are emerging as a promising foundation for embodied control: rather than predicting actions alone, they learn representations that couple action generation with future world prediction. This coupling is often viewed as a source of robustness, interpretability, and safety, as a robot's action can in principle be checked against its imagined future. items.title_cn: BadWAM：当世界-动作模型正确想象却错误行动
items.note: 揭示世界-动作模型的脆弱性，适合了解具身控制的安全问题。

items.title_en: Harness Handbook: Making Evolving Agent Harnesses Readable,Navigable, and Editable
items.summary: The capability of a modern AI agent depends not only on its foundation model but also on its harness, which constructs prompts, manages state, invokes tools, and coordinates execution. As models, APIs, environments, and requirements evolve, the harness must be continually modified. Before such a change can be made, a developer or coding agent must identify all code locations that implement the target behavior. items.title_cn: Harness Handbook：让演化的智能体框架可读、可导航、可编辑
items.note: 工具帮助开发者理解和修改智能体框架代码，适合了解智能体工程实践。

items.title_en: Boogu-Image-0.1: Boosting Open Agentic Multimodal Generation via Understanding under a Minimal Budget
items.summary: We introduce Boogu-Image-0.1, an open-source unified multimodal understanding and generation model family, comprising Base, Turbo, Edit, and Edit-Turbo variants. It delivers competitive performance in high-quality text-to-image generation, fast inference, instruction-based editing, and bilingual (Chinese-English) text rendering. items.title_cn: Boogu-Image-0.1：在极小预算下提升开放智能体多模态生成与理解
items.note: 开源统一多模态模型，支持生成、编辑、双语渲染，适合了解多模态模型。

items.title_en: Ring-Zero: Scaling Zero RL to a Trillion Parameters for Emergent Reasoning
items.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards without human-annotated data, often referred to as zero RL, has emerged as a powerful paradigm for eliciting chain-of-thought reasoning. However, due to computational constraints, existing studies are largely restricted to small models, leaving the training dynamics and emergent capabilities at a large scale unexplored. items.title_cn: Ring-Zero：将零强化学习扩展到万亿参数以实现涌现推理
items.note: 大规模零RL训练激发推理能力，适合了解强化学习与推理前沿。

items.title_en: KnowAct-GUIClaw: Know Deeply, Act Perfectly, Personal GUI Assistant with Self-Evolving Memory and Skill
items.summary: OpenClaw has emerged as a leading agent framework for complex task automation, yet it faces insufficient cross-platform GUI interaction support and a well-built self-evolution mechanism. These flaws limit its adaptation to diverse device ecosystems and prevent performance improvements through continuous learning from execution experience. items.title_cn: KnowAct-GUIClaw：深度认知、完美行动，带自演化记忆与技能的个人GUI助手
items.note: 个人助手框架通过记忆和技能自演化提升GUI交互，适合了解智能体应用。

items.title_en: OvisOCR2 Technical Report
items.summary: We introduce OvisOCR2, a 0.8B document parsing model. OvisOCR2 is designed as an end-to-end parser: given a document page image, it generates a Markdown representation in natural reading order, covering text, formulas, tables, and visual regions. huggingface.models_summary: 这些热门模型反映了两个趋势：一是模型规模两极分化，既有超大模型（如250B参数）追求性能，也有小模型（如3B参数）追求效率；二是多模态模型（同时处理图像和文本）越来越流行。对于想跟进AI圈和备考的人，值得注意：要理解模型参数量的意义，关注模型压缩技术，并学习多模态AI的基本概念，这些都是未来考试和行业的热点。
huggingface.papers_summary: 这批论文集中在几个热门方向：一是智能体（Agent）的自我改进、长上下文处理和多智能体协作；二是具身AI（Embodied AI），包括视觉-语言-动作模型、世界模型和机器人控制；三是多模态大模型（MLLM）的视频理解、图像生成和空间认知；四是训练技术，如强化学习、知识注入和模型缩放。备考AI新手应记住的关键词有：智能体、强化学习、多模态、具身AI、世界模型、知识图谱、RAG、扩散模型、Transformer架构。
